sql-modeling.name: Relational schema design
sql-modeling.description: Define table relationships, keys, uniqueness constraints, and normalization choices that enforce application data invariants.

database-transactions.name: Transaction isolation and locking
database-transactions.description: Choose transaction boundaries, isolation levels, and locking strategies, and test concurrent updates for lost writes and serialization failures.

rest-apis.name: RESTful APIs
rest-apis.description: Implement resource-oriented HTTP endpoints with validation, pagination, method and status-code semantics, and consistent error responses.

openapi-contracts.name: OpenAPI specifications
openapi-contracts.description: Describe API operations and schemas in OpenAPI for documentation and client integration.

orm-data-access.name: ORM query optimization
orm-data-access.description: Control eager and lazy loading, eliminate N+1 queries, and keep generated queries within explicit transaction boundaries.

database-indexing.name: Database indexing and query tuning
database-indexing.description: Use execution plans and workload measurements to improve indexes and database queries.

database-migrations.name: Database schema migrations
database-migrations.description: Version schema changes and apply them safely across application deployments.

caching.name: Cache invalidation and expiration
caching.description: Implement cache keys, TTLs, invalidation on writes, and stampede protection while testing stale-data behavior.

background-jobs.name: Background job processing
background-jobs.description: Run asynchronous work with retry policies, job state tracking, and failure recovery.

message-queues.name: Message acknowledgments and dead-letter queues
message-queues.description: Acknowledge messages after successful processing, bound retries, route failed deliveries to dead-letter queues, and support controlled redelivery.

webhook-integrations.name: Webhook signature verification and deduplication
webhook-integrations.description: Verify webhook signatures and timestamps, track event identifiers, and make duplicate deliveries safe to process.

rate-limiting.name: Rate limiting and throttling
rate-limiting.description: Protect services by enforcing fair request limits and handling overload predictably.

nosql-modeling.name: NoSQL data modeling
nosql-modeling.description: Choose document or key-value structures around access patterns and consistency needs.

search-indexing.name: Search indexing
search-indexing.description: Build searchable document indexes and keep them synchronized with source data.

real-time-apis.name: WebSocket and SSE connection management
real-time-apis.description: Manage live connections, heartbeats, reconnects, and subscription cleanup for WebSocket or server-sent event updates.

api-versioning.name: API versioning and compatibility
api-versioning.description: Evolve API contracts while preserving supported client behavior and migration paths.

service-resilience.name: Timeouts, retries, and circuit breakers
service-resilience.description: Set dependency timeouts, bound retries with backoff and jitter, and open circuit breakers to prevent cascading failures.

event-driven-architecture.name: Event schema versioning and replay
event-driven-architecture.description: Version event payloads, preserve consumer compatibility, and replay retained events without duplicating side effects.

database-replication.name: Database replication and availability
database-replication.description: Use replicas and failover strategies while accounting for replication lag and consistency.

partitioning-sharding.name: Data partitioning and sharding
partitioning-sharding.description: Distribute data by workload while managing hot partitions and cross-partition operations.

domain-driven-design.name: Bounded contexts and service boundaries
domain-driven-design.description: Separate domain models and service ownership around business capabilities, with explicit contracts for cross-boundary interactions.

distributed-transactions.name: Transactional outbox and sagas
distributed-transactions.description: Publish committed changes through a transactional outbox and coordinate cross-service workflows with compensating operations.

zero-downtime-migrations.name: Expand-contract database migrations
zero-downtime-migrations.description: Introduce compatible schema changes, backfill data, migrate readers and writers, and remove obsolete structures after compatibility checks.

multi-tenancy.name: Tenant isolation and resource quotas
multi-tenancy.description: Enforce tenant-scoped data access, partition shared resources, and apply quotas that contain noisy-neighbor workloads.
